en: The Great Wisdom Dhāraṇī of the Buddha’s Teaching on Amitāyus,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, Minister Dharma Xian, Grand Master of Enlightened Teaching, Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments,
and recipient of the title Chao San Da Fu, under imperial decree.
Namaḥ samyaksambuddhāya | Tadyathā | Oṃ sarvasaṅgharakṣāparijātadharmate gagana-samudgate svāhā ||
The Great Wisdom Dhāraṇī of Amitāyus Spoken by the Buddha.
